payload.text: AFTER THE CUT, guard strength in vc's own work, both found by cc's verification pass and both filed with measurements: 0057, ST0025's AT01 and AT02 pass on the single-stamp regression they name (cc measured 1237/1289/1237 in the centre bands and 0/0/0 in the margins with one A4 stamp over three pages), so the discriminator must key on the mark's SIZE scaling with the page -- the wide page's ink exceeding the A4 pages', or the ink's bounding box spanning most of each page's own width. 0058, tools/test-estate forces a PATH and not a VERSION, so on a machine where /bin/bash is not 3.2 the gate reports green having proved nothing; three lines reading /bin/bash --version and refusing by name.
